_doc: Climbable structures (ADR-0057): each provides "climb" and has its ladder or rope laid out in data/config/climbing.json (ClimbMount); Player climbs them as it climbs a POI ladder.

defs.name: Hunting Stand
defs.description: A log platform three metres up on four legs, a pole ladder inside the frame up to a hatch in the deck. Deer don't look up; Hollowed can't climb.

defs.name: Climbing Rope
defs.description: A knotted rope tied off to a stake, hanging over the edge.
